summary:
The Cape Sounion Tour leaves Athens for a guided journey along the Attica coast to the southern tip of the peninsula. The main visit is Cape Sounion, known for the ancient Temple of Poseidon and its position high above the Aegean Sea. The coastal drive makes the setting an important part of the excursion, rather than simply a transfer between Athens and the archaeological site.
After the visit, return to Athens by coach without the need for an overnight stay. The tour includes air-conditioned transportation, a professional English-speaking guide and entrance fees for the scheduled visit to the archaeological site.

itinerary.title: Cape Sounion Afternoon Tour

After the tour, return to Athens.

faqs.q: What is included in the Cape Sounion Tour?
faqs.a: The Cape Sounion Tour is a half-day excursion from Athens to one of Greece's most scenic coastal destinations. The tour includes transportation, guided sightseeing, and a visit to the famous Temple of Poseidon, perched dramatically above the Aegean Sea. Along the way, you will enjoy beautiful views of the Athens Riviera and the Saronic Gulf.

faqs.q: How much does the Cape Sounion Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €125 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes round-trip transportation, professional English-speaking guide services, and sightseeing according to the itinerary. Entrance fees may vary depending on the package selected.

faqs.q: How long does the Cape Sounion Tour last?
faqs.a: The tour lasts approximately 6 hours, including travel time from Athens. It is one of the most popular half-day excursions for travelers looking to combine history, mythology, and spectacular coastal scenery.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions visited during the tour?
faqs.a: The highlight of the tour is the Temple of Poseidon at Cape Sounion. Visitors also enjoy the scenic coastal drive along the Athens Riviera, panoramic views of the Aegean Sea, and opportunities to photograph one of Greece's most famous sunset locations.

faqs.q: Does the Cape Sounion Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the tour. Your guide will explain the history, mythology, and significance of Cape Sounion and the Temple of Poseidon while providing insights into the surrounding region.

Cape Sounion is famous for the Temple of Poseidon, dedicated to the Greek god of the sea. The site has been an important landmark for sailors since ancient times and is renowned for its dramatic cliff-top setting overlooking the Aegean Sea.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Visitors should be comfortable walking around the archaeological site and on gently sloping pathways. Most travelers of all ages and fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What should I wear for the Cape Sounion Tour?
faqs.a: Comfortable walking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat are recommended, especially during the summer months. A light jacket may be useful during evening departures when visiting for sunset.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Cape Sounion Tour?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 24 to 48 hours before the tour departure time, depending on the operator's policy. Cancellations made closer to departure may be subject to fees

faqs.q: Is the Cape Sounion Tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, the Cape Sounion Tour is highly recommended for first-time visitors. It combines Greek mythology, ancient history, stunning coastal landscapes, and one of the most beautiful viewpoints near Athens, making it one of the city's most popular excursions.
